description: Comparisons whose threshold is derived, in the same function, from the value being compared. May only SHRINK. Every entry here was read and is a legitimate data-derived threshold rather than a defect: median binarisation, a threshold taken from a baseline window and applied to a response window, clustering tolerance from typical spacing, adaptive noise floors, a cut position inside a string, and a first-half against second-half trend test — which is how a trend test SHOULD be written and looks exactly like the defect. Do not 'fix' these. The gate exists to catch the shape when it is real: a bar set from the result it judges.
